name: Outokumpu Oyj
summary: Outokumpu Oyj produces and sells various stainless-steel products in Finland, Germany, Italy, the United Kingdom, other European countries, North America, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through Europe, the Americas, Ferrochrome, and Other operations segments. The company offers cold rolled coils, strips, and sheets; hot rolled coils, strips, and plates; quarto plates; precision strips; and specialized components, such as welded stainless-steel I-beams, H-beams, hollow-section tubes, bent profiles, duprof structural sections, hardened and customized press plates, suction roll shells, and blancs and disks.
